products.title: Glass Food Storage Set, 12 Piece
bullets: Six borosilicate containers with six locking lids
Oven, microwave and dishwasher safe up to 750°F
Lids seal with four latches and a silicone gasket
Nests down to roughly one third of the stacked height
products.description: Borosilicate glass instead of plastic, so it goes from freezer to oven without cracking and doesn't hold onto tomato stains. The lids latch on four sides against a silicone gasket, which is what actually keeps soup in the container instead of in your bag.

products.title: 10-Inch Nonstick Skillet
bullets: Three-layer PFOA-free nonstick over a forged aluminum body
Flat magnetic base works on induction, gas and electric
Riveted stainless handle, oven safe to 450°F
Even heat across the base, no hot ring in the center
products.description: A forged aluminum pan heavy enough that it doesn't warp on high heat, with a nonstick coating rated for metal-free utensils. This is the egg-and-weeknight pan, not the sear-a-steak pan.

products.title: Electric Kettle, 1.7L Gooseneck
bullets: Five preset temperatures from 160°F to boiling
Gooseneck spout for slow, controlled pours
Stainless interior, no plastic in the water path
Holds a set temperature for 60 minutes
products.description: Variable temperature matters if you drink green tea or pour-over coffee — boiling water scorches both. The gooseneck gives you a thin, steady stream so you can actually control the pour rate.

products.title: Chef Knife Set, 8 Piece with Block
bullets: High-carbon stainless, full tang through the handle
Chef, santoku, bread, carving, utility and paring
Acacia block plus shears and a honing rod
Hand wash — dishwasher heat dulls the edge
products.description: Full-tang blades with the steel running the length of the handle, which is the difference between a knife that lasts a decade and one that loosens in a year. Comes sharp; keep it that way with the included rod.

products.title: Drill & Driver Bit Set, 120 Piece
bullets: S2 steel driver bits, titanium-coated twist drills
Phillips, slotted, square, Torx and hex in graduated sizes
Magnetic bit holder and a quick-change chuck adapter
Case is labeled by size and holds bits in place upside down
products.description: S2 steel on the driver bits, which is the grade that resists camming out under a impact driver. The case latches properly — the usual failure point on cheap sets is a lid that pops and dumps 120 bits in your truck.

products.title: Digital Multimeter, True RMS
bullets: True RMS reads distorted waveforms accurately, not just clean sine
CAT III 600V rated with fused current inputs
Auto-ranging with continuity, capacitance, frequency and diode test
Backlit display and a bright work light on the case
products.description: True RMS is the spec that matters — an averaging meter will read low on anything driven by a VFD, dimmer or switching supply. CAT III 600V with real fuses on the current jacks, not the unfused junk that shows up at this price.

products.title: 25 ft Magnetic Tape Measure
bullets: Magnetic hook grabs steel studs and conduit one-handed
13 ft of standout before the blade folds
Nylon-coated blade with a double-sided print
Impact case with a rubber overmold and belt clip
products.description: Thirteen feet of standout means you can measure a ceiling run alone. The magnetic hook is the other half of that — it catches on anything ferrous so you're not asking someone to hold the dumb end.

products.title: Rechargeable LED Work Light, 6000 Lumen
bullets: 6000 lumens on high, roughly 10 hours on low
IP65 sealed against dust and hose spray
Folding stand plus a magnetic base and hanging hook
USB-C in and out — runs as a power bank in a pinch
products.description: Bright enough to light a whole panel room off the stand. USB-C charging both ways means it takes the same cable as your phone and gives power back when you need it.

products.title: 65W GaN Charger, 3 Port
bullets: 65W total across two USB-C and one USA port
Charges most 13-inch laptops at full speed on the top port
Gallium nitride runs cooler and about half the size of silicon
Folding prongs, no wall-wart crowding
products.description: One brick for the laptop, phone and earbuds. GaN internals mean it's roughly the footprint of the old 30W Apple cube while pushing twice the power.

products.title: ANC Wireless Earbuds
bullets: Hybrid active noise cancellation with a transparency mode
8 hours per charge, 32 with the case
Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint to two devices
IPX5 sweat and rain resistant
products.description: Hybrid ANC with mics inside and outside the ear, which handles engine and HVAC drone well. Multipoint means they stay connected to your laptop and phone at the same time instead of making you re-pair.

products.title: 10,000 mAh Power Bank, 30W
bullets: 30W USB-C output charges a phone to half in about 25 minutes
Two full phone charges per pack
Under the 100Wh airline carry-on limit
Four-LED charge gauge, no guessing
products.description: Thirty watts out is the line between a power bank that keeps up with your phone and one that slowly loses ground while you use it. Slim enough for a jacket pocket.

products.title: Braided USB-C Cable, 6 ft 3-Pack
bullets: 100W power delivery, e-marked chip inside
Nylon braid over aluminum shells, 25,000 bend cycles
6 ft each — long enough to use the couch outlet
480 Mbps data, fine for backups and CarPlay
products.description: E-marked so it actually negotiates 100W instead of silently dropping to 60. The braid and the molded strain relief are why these outlast the cable that came in the box.

products.title: Orthopedic Dog Bed
bullets: 4-inch solid memory foam base, not shredded fill
Removable cover, machine wash cold
Waterproof inner liner over the foam
Non-slip bottom so it stays put on hardwood
products.description: Solid foam holds its shape under an older dog's weight — shredded fill flattens to nothing in a few months and stops doing anything for their joints. The liner under the cover is the part that saves the foam from accidents.

products.title: Self-Cleaning Slicker Brush
bullets: One button retracts the pins and releases the hair
Bent stainless pins with rounded tips
Works on undercoat without scratching skin
Rubber grip stays put in a wet hand
products.description: Press the button and the whole mat of hair lifts off the pins in one piece — that's the entire reason to buy this over a $4 brush. Pin tips are rounded so you can get down to the undercoat without leaving brush burn.

products.title: Elevated Stainless Bowl Set
bullets: Two 2-quart 304 stainless bowls, dishwasher safe
Bamboo frame with adjustable 8 or 12 inch height
Silicone feet, no sliding across tile
Bowls lift straight out for filling
products.description: Raised bowls cut the neck strain for big or older dogs. Stainless because plastic bowls scratch and hold bacteria in the grooves, and these go straight in the dishwasher.

products.title: Microfiber Towels, 24 Pack
bullets: 300 GSM split-weave, edgeless so nothing scratches paint
16 x 16 in, four colors to keep jobs separated
Holds about seven times its weight in water
Machine washable, no fabric softener
products.description: Edgeless means no stitched border to drag grit across a clear coat. Four colors so the wheel towels never end up on the hood — that's the mistake that puts swirl marks in paint.

products.title: Portable Jump Starter, 2000A
bullets: 2000 peak amps — starts up to 8.0L gas, 6.0L diesel
Reverse polarity and spark-proof clamps
Doubles as a 20,000 mAh power bank with a built-in light
Holds a charge on the shelf for about a year
products.description: Two thousand peak amps covers a cold truck, not just a commuter car. The clamps won't arc if you cross them, which is the part that makes this safe to leave in a glovebox for someone else to use.

products.title: Collapsible Utility Wagon
bullets: Folds to 8 inches deep, fits behind a back seat
150 lb load rating on a powder-coated steel frame
All-terrain wheels handle sand and gravel
600D fabric bed wipes clean, side pockets for small stuff
products.description: The wheels are the difference — the wide all-terrain ones roll on beach sand and job-site gravel where the narrow plastic wheels on cheap wagons dig in and stop.

shipping.title: Shipping
body: Free standard shipping on orders over $35. Below that, shipping is calculated by item weight class at checkout — $3.95 light, $5.95 standard, $11.95 heavy or oversize.
Orders placed before 2pm Eastern on a business day ship the same day. Everything else ships the next business day.
Standard delivery runs 3-6 business days within the continental US. We do not currently ship to PO boxes, APO/FPO addresses, Alaska, Hawaii or outside the US.
You get a tracking number by email as soon as the label scans. If tracking hasn't moved in 5 business days, email us and we'll open a claim and reship.

returns.title: Returns
body: Thirty days from delivery. The item needs to be unused and back in its original packaging.
No restocking fee. Return shipping is on you unless the item arrived damaged, defective or wasn't what you ordered — in those cases we email you a prepaid label.
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return arriving at our warehouse.
Damaged on arrival: email a photo within 7 days and we replace it or refund it. Don't ship it back.

contact.title: Contact
body: Email help@REPLACE-DOMAIN.com and a person answers within one business day, Monday through Friday.
Include your order number if you have one. It's in your confirmation email and starts with SDS-.
We don't have a phone line. Email gets you a faster answer and a written record of what we agreed to.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: REPLACE THIS PAGE before launch. This is placeholder text, not a legal policy, and it will not satisfy CCPA, GDPR or state disclosure requirements.

You will need to describe: what personal data you collect, why, how long you keep it, who you share it with (payment processor, shipping carrier, analytics and ad platforms), and how someone requests deletion.
If you run a Meta pixel or GA4, you are sharing data with those companies and you have to say so here by name.

terms.title: Terms
body: REPLACE THIS PAGE before launch. Placeholder text, not legal terms.
You will need: order acceptance and pricing-error terms, limitation of liability, warranty disclaimers, governing law, and dispute resolution.

If you advertise a compare-at price anywhere on the site, US FTC rules require that price to be a genuine former or prevailing market price. Invented MSRPs are the single most common source of deceptive pricing claims against small stores.

faq.a: Before 2pm Eastern on a business day, it ships the same day. Otherwise the next business day.
Free over $35. Under that it's $3.95 to $11.95 depending on the item's weight class.
Thirty days, unused, in the original box. No restocking fee.

faq.q: What if my item arrives damaged?
faq.a: Email a photo within 7 days and we replace it or refund it, no return shipping needed.
Compare-at prices reference the manufacturer's list price. If we can't verify a list price, we don't show one.
